text: AvtoVAZ is wholly state-owned through FSUE NAMI: in May 2023 Rostec State Corporation withdrew from AvtoVAZ's shareholders, transferring its 32.3% share in Lada Auto Holding (the joint venture controlling AvtoVAZ) to FSUE NAMI, a federal state unitary enterprise subordinate to Russia's Ministry of Industry and Trade, which thereby became the 100% owner.
short: FSUE NAMI, a state institute under the Ministry of Industry and Trade, is the 100% owner of AvtoVAZ.

source.name: NAPI (National Industrial Information Agency): NAMI received a share in AVTOVAZ from Rostec
source.quote: Now the 100% owner of the company controlling AVTOVAZ is FSUE NAMI.

additionalSources.name: AUTOSTAT analytic agency: Rostec transferred its shares in AVTOVAZ to FSUE NAMI
additionalSources.quote: Thus, now FSUE "NAMI" has become a 100% owner of AVTOVAZ.
additionalSources.note: The same article states FSUE NAMI is 'subordinated to the Ministry of Industry and Trade'.
